name: Reset Rows Table, If Necessary
purpose: Virtual List module: checks that the VirtualListRows table has at least 1000 records numbered 1..n in sequence; if not, deletes all rows, resets the serial number of VirtualListRows::n to 1 and creates 1000 empty rows.
writes:
delete: VirtualListRows (Delete All Records step 37, all records)
VirtualListRows::n#1 (Set Next Serial Value step 42, next value 1)
VirtualListRows (New Record/Request step 48, 1000 new records)
